items.title: Trump admin. urges Apple not to purchase Chinese memory chips, but this presents a problem
items.summary: US Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick says the Trump administration does not want Apple (AAPL) to purchase memory chips from China. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains why this presents issues for Apple.

items.title: Micron Vs. SK Hynix: The Newcomer is a Legitimate Threat
items.summary: SK Hynix just landed on NASDAQ with a record quarter and a $26.5 billion debut, putting it on the same exchange as Micron for the first time. Whether the HBM incumbent can match the contractual fortress Micron has quietly built around its revenue is a different question entirely.
